description: This file contains benchmark code for the 'softargmax_q8' operation, part of the QNNPACK library used within PyTorch. It sets up a benchmarking environment to test the performance of the softargmax operator on quantized 8-bit input data, including initialization, creation, setup, execution, and cleanup of the operator. It also defines parameterized benchmarks for various input sizes.
